## Goal
The monthly toast says "In the last month: ... N sites confirmed or no longer listing you" (`notify.py:78-84`), but `progress_counts` counts every status that is CONFIRMED or REMOVED right now, whatever its age (`notify.py:71-74`). After a year the toast keeps repeating a growing total as if it were new. Count only statuses whose `updated_at` (`models.py:698`) is on or after the window start `since`, ignore the reserved ids that start with `_` as today, and keep counts only (no names). Also make a marker that cannot be written (read-only folder) skip the toast rather than send one every run: today the first call's write is unguarded (`notify.py:102`) and the later one runs after the check (`notify.py:107`), so a failing write means the 30-day clock never advances (`cli.py:325-330` swallows the error). Practice-mode requests stay uncounted (`dry_run`).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Fake store with 3 CONFIRMED statuses updated 2 days ago, 3 updated 90 days ago: `progress_counts` reports `confirmed == 3`.
2. A status whose `updated_at` equals `since` exactly counts (inclusive); one a second earlier does not.
3. Dry-run requests are not counted in `sent`; requests sent before `since` are not counted.
4. When the marker cannot be written (point `home` at a read-only or missing folder via `tmp_path`), `maybe_monthly_progress` returns False and sends nothing, and does not raise.
5. Existing wording in `progress_body` is unchanged (same strings for the same counts); `tests/test_notify_monthly.py` passes unchanged.
6. The toast text and the counts never contain a name or broker id.
